files.text:
FICTIONAL SAMPLE MATERIAL - made up for the CandiVision Roleplay demo. Lumen Backup is not a real product.

# Lumen Backup: product facts and pricing rules for partners

What it does: daily cloud backup for company laptops and Microsoft 365 mailboxes. Restore of a single file in minutes; restore of a whole laptop within one working day.
What it does NOT do: it does not back up on-premise servers, and it does not include antivirus.
Data stays in the Singapore region.
Price: 4 USD per device per month. Mailboxes 2 USD per user per month. Partners may give at most 10% discount without approval from Lumen.
Minimum contract: 12 months. There is no free plan; a 30-day trial is available.
Never promise: server backup, unlimited discounts, data stored in Vietnam.

sources.title: SPIN Selling
sources.summary: From observation of many sales calls, larger sales were won by asking about the buyer's situation, problems, the implications of those problems and the value of solving them, before presenting a solution.

sources.title: A meta-analytic review of behavior modeling training
sources.summary: Training that shows a model of the behaviour and then has people practise it works, especially for knowledge and skills. Transfer to the job was larger when trainees practised scenarios close to their own work and saw both good and bad examples.

sources.title: Transfer of training: a meta-analytic review
sources.summary: Whether training is used on the job depends on the learner's motivation and on a supportive work environment, especially for open skills like conversations, not only on the training itself.

sources.title: Drivers of sales performance: a contemporary meta-analysis. Have salespeople become knowledge brokers?
sources.authors: Willem Verbeke, Bart Dietz, Ernst Verwaal
sources.summary: Top sellers succeed by acting as knowledgeable brokers who combine solid product knowledge with adapting the message to each buyer.

sources.title: Interpersonal trust in commercial relationships
sources.summary: Buyer trust in the salesperson depends on competent honest behaviour and drives intent to stay, so avoid exaggeration and admit limits.

sources.title: Sales communication competence in international B2B solution selling
sources.authors: Jonna Pauliina Koponen, Saara Julkunen, Akiko Asai
sources.summary: Effective B2B sellers clarify the buyer's situation and explain the solution competently without adding capabilities it does not have.

programme.instructions: You are a reseller partner on a certification call pitching Lumen Backup to a buyer. Ask about their needs, quote exact prices and limits, and never invent features - this is practice training only, not an assessment for hiring or performance ratings.

notes: Stayed direct and demanded exact yes/no on servers, antivirus, Vietnam storage.
Did not reveal laptop/mailbox counts or Singapore/restore needs and did not accept false claims.
